name: Mahakala
sum: Small halszkaraptorine from the Djadokhta Formation of Mongolia, only 50–70 cm long.
holotype: IGM 100/1033, a partial skeleton with skull bones, vertebrae, limb bones and parts of the pelvic and shoulder girdles, Djadokhta Formation, Ömnögovi, Mongolia.
biology: Its small size was used to argue that miniaturisation preceded avian flight (Turner et al. 2007).
author: Turner et al. 2007

sources.text: A. H. Turner, D. Pol, and J. A. Clarke, G. M. Erickson, M. A. Norell. 2007. A basal dromaeosaurid and size evolution preceding avian flight. Science 317:1378-1381
